FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Quick answers to the questions buyers ask most.

Do you offer one-time audits?
Yes. Strategic audits include technical, content, backlink, and AI visibility analysis with a prioritized roadmap. Suitable for in-house teams that need senior validation.
How do we get started?
Request a free growth audit. You receive a 25+ page report with a 90-day roadmap and revenue projections. If we are a fit, we propose an engagement. If not, you keep the audit.
How long does it take to see results from our PPC services?
Most Shahab Abbasi clients see meaningful ranking and traffic movement in 60-90 days, with revenue impact compounding from month 4 onward. our PPC services requires consistent execution and a clean technical foundation to deliver durable growth.
What does our PPC services cost in 2026?
Retainers for our PPC services typically start at $1,750/month for early-stage brands and scale to $12,500+/month for enterprise programs. Pricing depends on competitiveness, content volume, and target market. Custom plans are available.
Do you guarantee results for our PPC services?
Yes. We offer a 90-day ROI guarantee: if we do not hit the agreed milestone, we work free until we do. Few agencies are willing to put it in writing, but we do.
How is our PPC services different from generic SEO?
our PPC services is purpose-built for the buyer behavior, schema, and platform constraints of your specific niche. Generic SEO frameworks miss the conversion patterns that matter.
Do you work with in-house teams?
Yes. We embed with in-house marketing, engineering, and content teams to accelerate execution. We can run fully managed engagements or fractional consulting depending on your stage.
How do you track AI search visibility?
We track citations across ChatGPT search, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews using both automated monitoring and weekly manual sampling. Citation rate is reported alongside classic ranking KPIs.
